description: Sunny Deol and Akshaye Khanna can be seen again in the upcoming drama on Netflix, Ikka, with a different story. It is an interesting story in which an honest lawyer gets stuck.
title: Ikka Starring Sunny Deol and Akshay Khanna to Stream Soon on Netflix: What You Need to Know

description: The James Webb Space Telescope has discovered the most distant galaxy ever observed, JADES-GS-z14-0, seen as it existed just 300 million years after the Big Bang. Its unexpected brightness and chemical complexity suggest rapid early star formation, challenging long-standing theories about how the first galaxies evolved in the early universe.
title: James Webb Telescope Discovers Most Distant Galaxy From Just 300 Million Years After the Big Bang

description: It is an exciting new Indo-Korean romance shot in Seoul. Taking you on a journey of heartfelt detours, Made In Korea is about a fresh cross-cultural tale. It is about a girl who wants to move to South Korea and fulfil her dreams after her dreams of visiting the place are shattered because of his betrayal.
title: Made in Korea OTT Release: Cast, Plot, Trailer, and Where to Watch Priyanka Mohan’s Indo-Korean Drama

description: Blue Origin has announced a temporary halt to flights of its New Shepard spacecraft, pausing its suborbital space tourism business for at least two years. The company says the decision will free resources to accelerate development of its Blue Moon lunar lander for NASA’s Artemis programme, including robotic tests and a planned crewed Moon landing later this decade as part of a broader shift toward deep-space exploration and infrastructure development.
title: Blue Origin Halts New Shepard Space Tourism for at Least Two Years

description: YouTube, on Wednesday, announced that its artificial intelligence (AI)-powered auto-dubbing feature is now being expanded to everyone. The feature can automatically transcribe and translate a video’s spoken words into a different language, allowing even those who do not speak the language understand the content. It was first introduced at VideoCon 2023 as a pilot, and then in 2024, it was expanded to knowledge and information-focused videos.
title: YouTube’s Auto-Dubbing Is Now Available to All Users With 27 Supported Languages, New Features

description: Affordable ANC headphones under Rs. 10,000 now deliver a mix of strong audio, long battery life, and useful extras like app support and multipoint connectivity. This list highlights models such as the Noise Master Buds Max with claimed 40dB ANC and 60-hour playback, the lightweight Sony WH-CH720N, and the Skullcandy Hesh ANC with rapid charging. It also includes the Soundcore Space One with adaptive ANC and LDAC, and the JBL Tune 770NC offering up to 70 hours of playback with fast charging.
title: Best Headphones with ANC Under Rs 10,000 in India: Noise Master Buds Max, Sony WH-CH720N, and More

description: Faraday Future, a Los Angeles, California-based tech firm, introduced three new series of robot products during the annual National Automobile Dealers Association (NADA) Show in Las Vegas on Wednesday. The launch marks Faraday Future’s first major public unveiling of its embodied AI (EAI) robotics lineup, which the company says will go on sale immediately and aims to complement its intelligent mobility strategy.
title: Faraday Future Launches its First Series of Multipurpose AI-Powered Humanoid and Bionic Robots

description: iQOO Z11 5G and Z11 Lite 5G were launched last year. Now, rumours about the new Z lineup started appearing online. While iQOO is yet to confirm its existence, the iQOO Z11 5G and Z11 Lite 5G have reportedly been spotted in the IMEI database. The listing reveals the name and model number of the unannounced phones.  The iQOO Z11 5G and Z11 Lite 5G are expected to offer improvements over the iQOO Z10 and iQOO Z10 Lite 5G models.
title: iQOO Z11 5G, iQOO Z11 Lite 5G Reportedly Listed on IMEI Database Ahead of Anticipated Debut

description: Oppo Find X9s is tipped to be among the first smartphones in India to feature MediaTek’s new Dimensity 9500s chipset, built on a 3nm process for efficient flagship performance. The handset is reportedly targeting a Q2 2026 launch in India and other Asian markets. Leaks suggest it may offer a compact 6.3-inch 1.5K AMOLED 120Hz display, slimmer bezels, and a triple rear camera setup with 200-megapixel sensors. A near-7,000mAh battery and wireless charging are also expected.
title: Oppo Find X9s to Launch in Global Markets Including India With MediaTek Dimensity 9500s SoC: Report

description: Oppo Reno 15c 5G is now on sale in India via Amazon in Afterglow Pink and Twilight Blue colour options. The new smartphone is sold in 8GB+256GB and 12GB+256GB RAM and storage configurations. Launched in India on January 8, the Oppo Reno 15c 5G is equipped with Qualcomm’s octa core Snapdragon 6 Gen 1 chipset. The SoC is paired with an Adreno 710 GPU, up to 12GB of LPDDR4x RAM, and up to 512GB of UFS 3.1 onboard storage. It carries a triple rear camera setup, headlined by a 50-megapixel primary shooter.
title: Oppo Reno 15c 5G With 7,000mAh Battery, 50-Megapixel Camera Goes on Sale in India: Price, Offers

description: Blizzard is hitting a major reset on Overwatch 2, dropping the "2" from the game's title, adding 10 new heroes, and a year-long story arc to the game. As part of major revamp, Overwatch will get six new season of content in 2026, beginning with Season 1 on February 10. The game will also be released on Nintendo Switch 2 in spring.
title: Overwatch 2 Rebrands to 'Overwatch' as Blizzard Announces 10 New Heroes, Year-Long Story, Switch 2 Version

description: Sony sold 8 million units of its PlayStation 5 console, which is in its sixth year on the market, in the key October-December quarter - a 16 percent decline from the same period a year earlier. Profit at the gaming unit grew 19 percent to JPY 140.8 billion, helped by higher sales of software and a weaker yen.
title: Sony Sells 8 Million PS5 Units in Q3 FY 2025, Reports 19 Percent PlayStation Profit Growth

description: Anthropic fired shots at OpenAI and ChatGPT on Wednesday with its new Super Bowl commercials. The Claude-maker dropped four different advertisements, with each targeting ads in AI chatbots. While no rival company or product was mentioned directly, the ChatGPT-maker recently announced that it is testing ads in the chatbot, making the connection obvious for viewers.
title: Anthropic’s Super Bowl Ad Takes a Dig at ChatGPT’s Ads, OpenAI CEO Hits Back

description: The iQOO 15R is set to be launched in India later this month. In the days leading up to the launch, the company has been revealing details about the latest addition to the flagship iQOO 15 lineup. The latest teaser from the Vivo sub-brand sheds light on the photography capabilities of the upcoming handset. The iQOO 15R is confirmed to be equipped with a 50-megapixel camera. Separately, the brand has announced a sneak peek session for the iQOO 15R.
title: iQOO 15R Confirmed to Feature 50-Megapixel Sony LYT Camera Sensor: Expected Specifications, Features

description: Netflix’s Love (2025) is a highly anticipated romantic drama series starring Arjun Das and Aishwarya Lekshmi. Directed by Balaji Mohan, the show presents a realistic take on relationships, disagreements, and emotional growth. Streaming in multiple languages in October 2025, Love aims to connect deeply with modern audiences through simple, heartfelt storytelling.
title: Love (2025) OTT Release Revealed: What You Need to Know About This Upcoming Romantic Series

description: Oppo K14 Turbo and Oppo K14 Turbo Pro will be launched by the smartphone maker in China in April, a tipster claims. The two phones are expected to be powered by the flagship octa core MediaTek Dimensity 9500 chipset, which is built on a 3nm process. The Oppo K14 Turbo series is said to go on sale in China in 12GB+256GB, 12GB+512GB, and 16GB+512GB RAM and storage configurations. Both handsets could be available in white, gray, pink, and forged carbon (translated from Chinese) colourways.
title: Oppo K14 Turbo Series Launch Timeline Tipped Along With Key Specifications, Memory Configurations

description: Samsung Galaxy A07 5G has been launched in India. The new smartphone, which is powered by a MediaTek Dimensity 6300 chipset, packs a 6,000mAh battery. It supports 25W wired fast charging. The smartphone is currently on sale in the country via the Samsung India online store. It is offered in 4GB+129GB and 6GB+128GB RAM and storage configurations. The phone can be purchased in Light Violet, Light Green, and Black colour options. It features a dual rear camera setup, with a 50-megapixel primary shooter and a 2-megapixel depth sensor.
title: Samsung Galaxy A07 5G Launched in India With 6,000mAh Battery, 50-Megapixel Rear Camera: Price, Specifications

description: Netflix’s Super Subbu stars Sundeep Kishan in a refreshing social comedy that tackles a taboo topic with humour and heart. Directed by Mallik Ram, the series promises laugh-out-loud moments while exploring family pressure, relationships, and personal dreams. With strong performances and a bold concept, Super Subbu is one of Netflix’s most awaited Telugu originals.
title: Super Subbu OTT Release Confirmed: Everything You Need to Know

description: Xiaomi 17 Ultra could soon be available in global markets. The company has not yet revealed the launch date. However, a new leak has surfaced online, giving us a closer look at its design language. The Xiaomi 17 Ultra was released in China in December last year with a 6.9-inch AMOLED display, Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset, Leica-branded cameras and a 6,800mAh battery. The global variant is rumoured to feature a 6,000mAh battery.
title: Xiaomi 17 Ultra Global Variant Spotted in Leaked Image That Reveals Display Design, Key Specifications

description: Apple has long been rumoured to be developing a low-cost MacBook to compete in the non-premium laptop market. While such plans are yet to be made official, a recent report suggests that the Cupertino-based tech giant is confident that the purported laptop will be received well in terms of sales and expects to ship about 8 million units, owing to its relatively low price. The company has reportedly finalised the memory supply of the low-cost MacBook, which may be powered by the A18 Pro chip.
title: Apple’s Low-Cost MacBook With A18 Chip, 8GB RAM to Launch at a Competitive Price: Report

description: Asus Zenbook S16 (UM5606GA) and Zenbook 14 (UM3406GA) have been launched in India and the laptop models are available to pre-book in the country. They will be launched on February 12. Asus will also launch the new Vivobook lineup in the country on the same date. The lineup includes Vivobook S16 (M3607GA), Vivobook 16 (M1607GA), Vivobook 15 (M1502NAQ), and Vivobook 16 (M1605NAQ).
title: Asus Zenbook S16, Zenbook 14 Launched in India Alongside New Vivobook Models: Price, Specifications

description: Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick has said that generative AI has "zero part" in GTA 6 development. The executive said that the company utilised AI as productivity tools, but not for creativity. Zelnick said that AI tools will not create great entertainment properties.
title: Generative AI Has 'Zero Part' in GTA 6, Says Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick

description: The OTT platforms are coming with anticipated series and movies like Kis Kisko Pyaar Karoon 2, The Raja Saab, Parasakthi, and more.
title: OTT Releases of the Week (Feb 2 - Feb 8): The Raja Saab, Kis Kisko Pyaar Karoon 2, Psych Siddhartha, Parasakthi, and More

description: Vivo X300 Ultra will be launched soon with a quad rear camera setup, according to a tipster. The phone is said to feature a 200-megapixel primary camera on the back, along with a 200-megapixel telephoto shooter, a 50-megapixel ultrawide camera, and a 5-megapixel camera for improved colour accuracy. On the front, it might sport a 50-megapixel selfie camera with auto-focus. The rumoured handset will reportedly be backed by a 7,000mAh battery with support for 100W wired and 40W wireless fast charging.
title: Vivo X300 Ultra Tipped to Launch in India With Four Rear Cameras, 7,000mAh Battery

description: Xiaomi-backed Black Shark may soon launch its new gaming tablet globally, as the Black Shark Gaming Tablet has appeared on the brand’s global website. It features an 8.8-inch 2.5K display with a 144Hz refresh rate and up to 600 nits brightness. The tablet is powered by the Snapdragon 8s Gen 3 SoC, paired with 12GB RAM and 256GB storage. It packs a 7,300mAh battery, dual speakers, vapour chamber cooling, and runs Android 16.
title: Xiaomi's Black Shark Gaming Tablet Listed on Global Website With Snapdragon 8s Gen 3, 8.8-Inch 144Hz Display

description: Google, on Wednesday, announced the quarterly financial results for Q4 2025. During the earnings call with investors and analysts, company CEO Sundar Pichai revealed that Google’s parent Alphabet crossed $400 billion (roughly Rs. 36.07 lakh crore) in annual revenue for the first time. The massive revenue milestone comes on the back of the company’s massive push into artificial intelligence (AI) technology, and increased demand from consumers and enterprises.
title: Google Hits Historic $400B Revenue Amid Massive AI Push: 5 Things You Should Know

description: Realme P4 Power 5G is now on sale in India with prices starting at Rs. 25,999. It features a 10,001mAh silicon-carbon battery with 80W fast charging, a 144Hz curved 1.5K display, and a MediaTek Dimensity 7400 Ultra chipset. The handset offers up to 12GB RAM and 256GB storage, a 50-megapixel Sony main camera with OIS, vapour chamber cooling, and an IP66+IP68+IP69-rated durable build. Launch offers are available across online and offline channels.
title: Realme P4 Power 5G With 10,001mAh Battery, 50-Megapixel Camera Goes on Sale in India: Price, Offers

description: The Samsung Galaxy S26 series is expected to go official later this month as the company’s next-generation flagship lineup. In recent weeks, the rumour mill has suggested that the top-of-the-line Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra could be equipped with built-in magnets that add 25W Qi2 wireless charging support. A tipster, however, claims that while the purported Galaxy handset will support wireless charging via magnets, it will be through magnetic cases and not built-in magnets.
title: Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra Tipped to Rely on Magnetic Cases for Qi2 Charging Instead of Built-in Magnets

description: Spotify, on Wednesday, announced that it has started rolling out multiple updates for its in-app lyrics feature globally. Spotify's lyrics translation feature, which was only available in 25 countries, is now being rolled out globally to free and Premium subscribers. Additionally, the company is adding a lyrics preview feature, which displays small snippets of a song's lyrics under the album art. Lastly, Spotify also announced a new exclusive feature for Premium users, which allows them to download the lyrics for offline viewing.
title: Spotify Announces Lyrics Previews, Offline Lyrics; Begins Rolling Out Lyric Translation Globally

description: Apple recently released iOS 26.2.1 for iPhone, and while it added a key new feature, it is said to be causing some problems as well. The update brought support for the second-generation AirTag alongside fixes for several bugs, but users are facing system crashes and connectivity issues on their iPhone units since updating to the latest software version. The Cupertino-based tech giant, however, is yet to acknowledge the issue.
title: Apple’s iOS 26.2.1 Update Said to be Causing App Crashes, System Reboot and Connectivity Issues on iPhone

description: Apple released the release candidate (RC) versions of the upcoming iOS 26.3 and iPadOS 26.3 updates recently. It is said to include references to a pair of unreleased chips that are in the M5 family. It reportedly contains mentions of the M5 Max chip. The code also references what appears to be the M5 Ultra, and it could be used in the Mac Studio. Apple is expected to launch upgraded MacBook Pro models with new chips later this month or next month.
title: Apple’s iOS 26.3 RC Update Reportedly Contains References to Anticipated M5 Max, M5 Ultra Chips

description: The Google Pixel 10a will be launched in India and the global markets later this month, the company announced on Wednesday. It is anticipated to arrive as the successor to the Pixel 9a, which debuted in March 2025. Amid a myriad of leaks that hinted towards the design of the upcoming handset, the Mountain View-based tech giant has taken the wraps off the phone. The Pixel 10a will feature an identical design to its predecessor and be available in a blue colourway.
title: Google Pixel 10a Launch and Pre-Order Date Announced; Design and Blue Colourway Teased

description: Honor’s Magic V6 has been spotted on China’s 3C certification database, offering a new clue about its charging capabilities. The listing shows a 120W fast charger, suggesting the foldable may support up to 120W wired charging, although the company could restrict it to a lower rate. The certification is said to include two variants, one standard model and another with BeiDou-3 satellite messaging. The Magic V6 is set to launch at MWC Barcelona on March 1 with a Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 SoC, a large battery, and upgraded cameras.
title: Honor Magic V6 3C Listing Hints at Faster 120W Charging; Satellite Messaging Variant Also Spotted

description: Foldable smartphones launching in 2026 may introduce next-generation “multispectral” stylus support, according to tipster Smart Pikachu on Weibo. Honor’s Magic V6 is set to debut in March, alongside the expected launch of the Oppo Find N6, with Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 SoC, around 7,000mAh batteries, and 200-megapixel main cameras.
title: Oppo Find N6, Honor Magic V6 Tipped to Launch With Advanced Stylus Support, 7,000mAh Battery

description: Samsung is collaborating with another South Korea-based tech firm, Nota AI, to build a new AI-powered image generator feature, dubbed EdgeFusion, a tipster claims. The tech giant reportedly plans to integrate the EdgeFusion into its upcoming Samsung Galaxy S26 lineup, which could include the standard Galaxy S26, Galaxy S26+, and Galaxy S26 Ultra. The new flagship Galaxy S series phones will reportedly be launched by the company on February 25, while going on sale in March. However, the company has yet to confirm the launch and other details about the phones.
title: Samsung Galaxy S26 Series to Feature EdgeFusion Image Generator Developed in Partnership With Nota AI, Tipster Claims

description: Valve is having a hard time finalising the price and the release date for the Steam Machine, the Steam Frame VR headset, and the next-gen Steam controller due to ongoing RAM and storage shortages. In a new blog post, the company said it would launch new Steam hardware in the "first half of 2026".
title: Steam Machine May Be Delayed Due to RAM, Storage Shortages and Price Hikes

description: Talaash: A Mother’s Search is a Parineeti Chopra and Tahir Raj Bhasin starrer upcoming thriller web series that is set to land on Netflix soon. It follows the journey of a mother as she searches for her missing child.
title: Talaash: A Mother’s Search OTT Release Confirmed: Know Everything About This Upcoming Thriller Series

description: Vivo V70 series, which will include the Vivo V70 Elite and the standard Vivo V70, will be launched in India on February 19. Moreover, the tech firm claims that the smartphones will feature the narrowest bezels, measuring 1.25mm, in the under Rs. 50,000 price segment. The Vivo V70 Elite is confirmed to be powered by a Snapdragon 8s Gen 3 chipset. Meanwhile, the standard Vivo V70 will feature a Snapdragon 7 Gen 4 SoC. The series is confirmed to go on sale in India via Amazon, Flipkart, and the Vivo online store.
title: Vivo V70 Elite, Vivo V70 India Launch Date Announced: Expected Specifications, Features

description: Xiaomi’s magnetic modular lens system for phones was first teased as a concept at MWC 2025. While Xiaomi remain tightlipped about its launch, a new leak says it has entered the mass-production planning phase. It is said to arrive later this year. The Xiaomi Modular Optical System integrates the optical capabilities of a professional camera with the computational photography ability of a mobile phone. It features an all-6G aspherical lens assembly with a f/1.4 large aperture combined with a 35mm focal length. Users can attach the lens to their phone, and then they can experience the plug-and-play camera powered by Xiaomi AISP.
title: Xiaomi's Futuristic Modular Optical System Enters Production a Year After MWC 2025 Showcase, Tipster Claims
